llm.guidance: This skill appears internally consistent and low‑risk because it is instruction-only and asks for no credentials. Before installing, consider: (1) the skill will give deterministic statements (e.g., exact percent weights and timelines) but FICO models are proprietary and exact weights can vary — treat specifics as illustrative rather than authoritative; (2) never paste or share sensitive personal data (SSN, full account numbers, full credit reports) into the chat — the skill is not designed to handle secrets; (3) the included app links point to official stores, but if you follow them review the app's privacy policy and permissions; and (4) if you need legally binding advice or actions (filing disputes, contacting bureaus), prefer official channels or a licensed professional. Overall: technically coherent and low-risk, but verify any critical financial actions with authoritative sources.
